purpose: Third-party inspiration only; do not bundle as application assets.

images.title: Blue conversation composition
images.observation: A bright sky-blue field frames a rounded white conversation surface. The small tactile character and minimal circular controls add personality without increasing interaction complexity. Reinterpret the cheerful framing and clear hierarchy; do not reuse the character, name or mobile composition.

images.title: Conversation and document composition
images.observation: A conversation sits beside a readable document, with a shared blue visual family. Useful artifacts look substantial and approachable. This supports attractive media/result cards in our own conversation, not a requirement to copy a presentation dashboard.

images.title: Yellow conversation and connection composition
images.observation: Warm yellow surrounds white conversation surfaces, rounded source cards and an obvious connected state. The usable pattern is immediate visual feedback with a consistent accent. The specific character, document text and phone frames are reference content.

images.title: Underdog Mac application composition
images.observation: A pale Mac workspace sits in an imaginative pastel landscape. Dark text, simple input and a task preview retain readability. The important relationship is expressive surroundings with a calm work surface; the dog, email example, tab system and task workflow are not our product specification.

images.title: Underdog launch-page crop
images.observation: Large type, generous white space, a colorful display-word accent and bold pill-shaped calls to action make the proposition approachable. Our application should find its own typography and identity rather than adopt the rainbow italic treatment, dog or download copy.

images.title: Underdog model-family composition
images.observation: Different illustrated dogs, large figures and handwritten accents turn technical offerings into something personable. This suggests human presentation of capabilities, not a model marketplace, copied dog family or adoption of the displayed performance claims.

images.title: Atmospheric transition crop
images.observation: A soft peach and lavender horizon descends into a dark field. The crop demonstrates a composed transition between light and dusk. Its usefulness is atmospheric color and pacing, not more interface controls.

images.title: Underdog manifesto composition
images.observation: Soft horizon color gives way to large editorial typography and a simple rounded panel. Type variation creates warmth and emphasis. Keep our own wording and avoid reproducing its distinctive slogan or typographic signature.

images.title: Underdog team and backer composition
images.observation: Generous white space and strong type carry most of the composition; small multicolor accents provide personality. The design lesson is that a playful identity does not require dense illustration everywhere. None of the displayed team or backer statements belongs to our product.

images.title: Blue rounded-panel crop
images.observation: A large blue-to-muted-lavender rounded field is shown largely without content. This isolates the background treatment: soft, broad color and generous corner curvature. It should inform material tests rather than become a blank panel copied verbatim.

images.title: Hark conversation and source stack
images.observation: A blue atmospheric panel contains readable messages and a lightly overlapping stack of article cards. Soft depth makes outputs feel tangible. Reuse the principle of attractive result objects without importing its news content, stack layout or agent behavior.

images.title: Hark floating work surfaces
images.observation: White rounded work surfaces float over a blue-to-peach field. Clear silhouettes and simple controls suggest a friendly spatial quality. Translate that depth into our own sheets and previews; do not recreate a browser/computer workspace from the marketing example.

images.title: Hark connection-sheet composition
images.observation: A pale translucent connection panel floats over a sky-colored environment, with clear labels and comfortable controls. This is a material and hierarchy reference for our simulated consent sheets. The illustrated code is third-party demo content and must never be treated as an actual credential or input instruction.

images.title: Hark action-control composition
images.observation: A series of pale rounded strips sits over a lavender/coral field, with clear action words and recognizable service marks. The lesson is legible affordance and soft color. It does not add payment, prescription, travel or autonomous-action requirements to our interface.

images.title: Hark information-card composition
images.observation: Several pale cards use a common layout and readable type over a cool atmospheric background. The consistent surface language is useful. The financial, exercise, purchase and travel examples are fictional/reference content, not features to reproduce.

images.title: Hark atmospheric hero crop
images.observation: A very broad pale-blue and cyan luminous form supplies atmosphere behind simple foreground controls. It illustrates how light and depth can be produced by an abstract field. The sign-in form is not appropriate to our account-free local setup.

images.title: Dots desktop-window examples
images.observation: Simplified neutral desktop windows sit within softly textured colored environments. Small task-state accents make them understandable without dominating. This is visual evidence for textured atmosphere and clear state, not a requirement for a persistent computer-use agent.

images.title: Dots yellow connection composition
images.observation: Warm yellow, white rounded connection cards, a tactile small character and ample spacing make connecting tools feel approachable. Our app can use the hierarchy and warmth; the character, exact cards and desktop framing remain third-party identity.

images.title: Dots coral task composition
images.observation: A pale task surface sits on coral, with a small expressive character and a highly legible stop control. The useful ideas are clear active state and an inviting accent. Our preparation jobs can inherit that clarity without copying the character or task interface.

images.title: Dots magenta work composition
images.observation: A light work surface is framed by a saturated pink/magenta field. The surrounding color is expressive while the content remains readable. It demonstrates a controlled high-energy moment, not a mandate to show Slack, copy its brand or add team collaboration.

images.title: Underdog illustrated meadow
images.observation: A soft surreal landscape combines sky, water, organic forms and architecture, with a small resting dog. It conveys ease, imagination and a place one might want to enter. An original illustration could eventually play that emotional role, but the scene, dog and recognizable composition must not be reused in our application.
